Class Event

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.events.Event
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEvent
public class Event extends Object implements IEvent
Concrete implementation of IEvent representing a social event.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event(String title, int capacity, String category)
      Creates an Event with a maximum attendee capacity.

      All other fields are assigned via setters after instantiation.

      Parameters:
      title - the event title; must not be null
      capacity - the maximum number of attendees; must be greater than zero
      category - the event category; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if title or category is null, or capacity is less than one

    • Event

      public Event(String title, String category)
      Creates an Event with no maximum attendee capacity.

      All other fields are assigned via setters after instantiation.

      Parameters:
      title - the event title; must not be null
      category - the event category; must not be null
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if title or category is null

    • setDateTime

      public void setDateTime(LocalDateTime startDateTime, LocalDateTime endDateTime)
      Description copied from interface: IEvent
      Sets the start and end date/time for this event.

      An event can only be assigned a date and time once it has been given a location.

      Specified by:
      setDateTime in interface IEvent
      Parameters:
      startDateTime - when the event begins; must not be null
      endDateTime - when the event ends; must not be null and must be after startDateTime
